Definition: middle voice from G4253 and a derivative of G5495; to handle for oneself in advance, i.e. (figuratively) to purpose:--choose, make.
BiblicalUsage: Procheirizomai means to choose beforehand, to handle in advance, to appoint. God tells Ananias that he has chosen Paul to know his will, and Jesus tells Paul he has appeared to make him a minister and a witness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe appointment comes from God, not from men, and Paul's whole life was chosen before he chose it.
